standard_prerequisites.name: The graph G with its dimension-regularity parameters, the constants M and the relation ln n >= (ln 2/(M-1)) d
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Set up in the author's introduction and preliminaries (source lines 201-240); used at the end of the counted proof
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the parameter relation that turns the exponential factor 2^{|R|} (1-p_-)^{2(M-1)|R|} into exp(-Omega(|R|)).

core_obligations: Set up the counting: put H = G[R] and m = e_G(R_1) + e_G(R_2), assume without loss that |R_2| >= |R_1|, and record the two identities relating the boundary size and m to the degree sums inside H (proof lines 1367-1371).

Define the exceptional set: X is the set of vertices of R with fewer than three quarters of d neighbours in H, or with more than a quarter of d neighbours inside their own class; by construction every vertex outside X has at least d/2 neighbours in the opposite class (proof lines 1372-1376).

Bound the exceptional set: the author's two identities give |X| <= 4 e_G(R,R^c)/d + 8m/d, so that the hypotheses e_G(R,R^c) <= K|R| log d and m <= K'|R| give |X| = O(|R| log d / d) (proof lines 1377-1379).
Count the bipartitions: choosing the small part inside X and the rest by their degrees produces the bound exp(O(|R| log^2 d / d)) (proof lines 1380-1414).
The weighted consequence: substituting the bound into the sum over bipartitions weighted by (1-p_-)^{theta m} and using ln n >= (ln 2/(M-1)) d gives exp(-Omega(|R|)) (proof lines 1405-1413).
proof_roadmap: 把 R 分成两部分，用次数求和把边界大小与内部边数 m 写成次数和；圈出坏顶点集 X 并把它的大小压到 O(|R| log d / d)。
在 X 内选出小的一侧、再按次数选择其余顶点，得到 bipartition 的计数上界 exp(O(|R| log^2 d / d))；代入加权和并用 ln n >= (log 2/(M-1)) d 得到 exp(-Omega(|R|))。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the counting lemma for bipartitions of a set with a small boundary (author lemma at source lines 1344-1364, label lem:two-colour-count), together with its weighted corollary eq:colouring-weight. The proof (source lines 1366-1414) has real content: it defines an exceptional set X of vertices that are either too poorly connected inside H or too concentrated in their own class (proof lines 1372-1376), bounds its size by a degree-summing computation that turns the boundary and internal-edge hypotheses into |X| = O(|R| log d / d) (proof lines 1377-1379), and then counts the admissible bipartitions by choosing the small side inside X and the remaining vertices by their degrees, which yields exp(O(|R| log^2 d / d)) (proof lines 1380-1404). The weighted consequence is obtained by substituting that bound and using the parameter relation ln n >= (ln 2/(M-1)) d (proof lines 1405-1413). H2.
